definitions.explanation: a stick or rod used by a wizard, witch, or fairy to cast spells, common in fairy tales, fantasy stories, and figurative expressions

examples.japanese: {魔法|まほう}の{杖|つえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}った→振る：01983_furu⟧。

examples.english: I wish I had a magic wand.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01629_seiji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{魔法|まほう}の{杖|つえ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。⟦{地道|じみち}→地道：15599_jimichi⟧な⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: There's no magic wand in politics. Steady effort is what's needed.

notes:
Combines ⟦{魔法|まほう}→魔法：14640_mahou⟧ (magic) with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ (possessive particle) and ⟦{杖|つえ}→杖：12862_tsue⟧ (cane, staff, stick). Used both literally in fairy tales and fantasy contexts and figuratively to mean a miraculous solution that solves problems instantly. The figurative use often appears in the negative: {魔法|まほう}の{杖|つえ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (there is no magic wand).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {魔法|まほう}の{杖|つえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}る→振る：01983_furu⟧: to wave a magic wand
- {魔法|まほう}の{杖|つえ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: there is no magic wand (figurative)
- {魔法|まほう}の{杖|つえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to get hold of a magic wand

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{杖|つえ}→杖：12862_tsue⟧: cane; walking stick; staff — the general word for a stick used for support or as a tool
- ⟦{魔法|まほう}→魔法：14640_mahou⟧: magic; sorcery — the broader concept of magic
- {打|う}ち{出|で}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{小槌|こづち}: magic mallet — a treasure from Japanese folklore that grants wishes when struck
